chapter: Leaving St. Louis: Toby show, Darrell Harris and Eli Rice
title: Joining Darrell Harris and his Black Diamond Orchestra
summary: Aged about 18, Thomas decided to make a move and joined the ten-piece Black Diamond Orchestra, led by Darrell Harris, in Fort Wayne, Indiana.

bands.name: Darrell Harris and his Black Diamond Orchestra

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: So that was running out so I said we'd better, for me I'd better and everybody is getting older and the money is getting shorter so it's about time to make a move and I'm blowing a little better now. I have more confidence now so this is it. I'm around 18 or something like that. So we made a trip, we were to a group (?) called Darrell Harris and his Black Diamond orchestra.
Yeah. It was a good band. Met him in Fort Wayne, Indiana.
This band is playing in the show, is it?
No, no. Darrell Harris is organizing a band to go on road trips. And, ...
No, I wondered how it connected up with this fellow who was in the show with the tuba and his wife was a dancer.
Well, damned if I know. I don't know how that happened. But, he seemed to know these people.
What do you mean, he knew Darrell Harris?

He must have known because he was getting ready to go on this trip so I (..?) and we talked over night and things were getting slow where I am but how he knew him I don't know. But, anyhow we just decided on this thing, you know, sounded good.
It's nothing happening in St. Louis so I got to go somewhere. Family has got to eat, I got to eat, so made this trip to Fort Wayne, Indiana.
Is that where (..?) worked with Darrell Harris band in Fort Wayne but Darrell Harris is a St. Louis band, is he?
